morocco population: Morocco population (2024): approximately 37.5 million (World Bank WDI, SP.POP.TOTL).
morocco gdp: Morocco GDP (2024): approximately $157 billion (World Bank WDI, NY.GDP.MKTP.CD).
morocco water: Morocco annual freshwater withdrawals: 10.573 billion m³ (reported through 2022, World Bank WDI, ER.H2O.FWTL.K3).
morocco freshwater: Morocco renewable freshwater per capita: 620 m³/year (2020), well inside the UN absolute water-scarcity threshold.
world bank: World Bank World Development Indicators (WDI) is a public database of development indicators.
